As orbital radius decreases, the gravitational potential energy of the satellite decreases.

As a result, total energy decreases and kinetic energy increases.

An increase in kinetic energy leads to an increase in orbital speed.

(Note: remember that gravitational potential energy is negative, so a decrease in gravitational potential energy means that its absolute value will be larger).
